summary: R31正式安装：用户暂停同步按设备耐久保存，重开Type继续暂停；明确继续同步/停止并保存才恢复。旧版独立进程反例已复现，修后跨进程及安装版本机读取成立；坏设置/保存失败保留原音并明确阻塞。
limitations: 本轮安装版本的暂停重开为隔离本机配置检查，不冒充新实板长录/GUI点击或录中断链验收；未改变MCU/编码/无线/云。实际仍App415/正常Boot415/UI77，06:49官方只读Boot确认无临时窗口，不必刷写。416物理安装断电route3仍待Owner当前时段；2h、低电/功耗、内容质量及>=100KiB/s仍开放，提速等Nordic。

corruptChoiceStatus.error: 录音同步设置暂时不可读取，自动同步已暂停；设备原录音保留。请恢复本机设置文件后重试。

changes: Persist only per-device user sync preference through existing atomic flush/replace, distinct from microphone controls, partial-file cursor, cloud processing and temporary coordinator handoff.

Ordinary and owned background followers retain pause after restart; explicit Continue/Stop-and-save persists resumed choice before receive. Resume failure closes an already-owned native connection before surfacing the error.

Unreadable/corrupt/unknown-version settings stop automatic receive; current pause still stops its job if saving fails, and failure is surfaced rather than claiming restart durability. Failed resume publication retains old in-memory choice.

UI explains restart persistence and no effect on device capture; blocked settings show the real error without a false Continue action. Read-only --recording-sync-status opens no BLE/recorder or cloud workflow.
Existing previously-untracked UI test/stub files are saved with four-line missing speaker-test export and affected assertions; their old contents are inherited, not all newly developed.
